_about: HELD-OUT set for policy retrieval. FROZEN: its SHA-256 is in retrieval_heldout.sha256 and eval_heldout.py refuses to run if the file changed. Never use it to tune anything. Written by the same author as the two fictional policies (an AI assistant working with the project owner), in a different voice from retrieval_dev.json: scenarios, indirect wording, and near-miss traps. Labels were assigned from the policy text, not from retrieval output. Still easier and more policy-aligned than real user questions; see evaluation/README.md for the protocol.
